title: Oversight Fatigue Simulation: Modeling How Sustained Oversight Degrades Over Time

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Understanding fatigue-induced degradation in oversight is practically relevant for pipeline design. However, the simulated fatigue (increasing error rate) is a simplified proxy for real degradation, limiting the directness of the safety chain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Simulating fatigue by increasing label error rates over time is straightforward to implement. Training a model under this corrupted supervision and measuring downstream quality is standard. Accessible for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: One simulation parameter (error rate schedule), one training run, one evaluation. Clear deliverable: a degradation curve. Well-scoped for 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
